Done. Here's what I built.

## Summary

I read the full paper (body + all appendices B–J in `PAPER.txt`, which contain the verbatim judge prompts, training hyperparameters, Petri prompts, and puzzle examples) and implemented the core experiments as a resumable, config-driven Python codebase scoped to Gemma + Gemini. **Nothing was run or tested** — and note this environment has no Python interpreter, so I reviewed correctness manually rather than byte-compiling.

**Coverage (all written, ~4,150 LOC):**
- **§2 Eliciting & quantifying distress** — 5 categories, multi-turn rollout engine, verbatim Claude-Sonnet-4 frustration judge, GPT-5-mini agreement validation, Figures 1–3 + Table 3/8 differential words.
- **§3 Base-vs-instruct prefilling** (Gemma only — Gemini has no base model, a paper-acknowledged limitation) — seed mining, verbatim onset-labelling + paraphrase, early/onset truncation, base vs instruct continuation.
- **§4 Interventions** — calm-data generation (verbatim reassuring prefix/suffix), SFT+DPO dataset construction, LoRA training via TRL (exact Table 9 hyperparameters), Petri open-ended elicitation (verbatim Appendix G auditor/judge prompts), and the capability-benchmark harness.
- **Appendix A** ablations (neutral-continuation / redacted-turns / fake-multiturn) and **Appendix I** logit-lens internal-emotion probing + layer-subset DPO ablation.

**Built for unattended multi-week scale:** append-only JSONL stores keyed by deterministic task IDs (idempotent resumption after any crash), retry/backoff with `Retry-After`, bounded concurrency, per-item fault isolation, rotating logs, a fail-fast `preflight.py`, and process-independent seeding so a resumed run on a different node reconstructs the same workload.

**`DESIGN.md`** documents every choice and filled gap with rationale — the response-counting convention, the verified-impossible puzzle generator, rejection pools, WildChat sampling, the DPO-pairing approximation, the self-contained Petri implementation, the Ekman lexicon for probing, and the explicit list of out-of-scope items and best-effort dataset coordinates.

**A couple of things worth flagging:**
- A few experiments depend on HuggingFace datasets (`Dolci-Instruct-SFT`, WildChat, capability benchmarks) for exact parity — all degrade gracefully with logged fallbacks, but you'll want Hub access on the run nodes.
- Local Gemma (base models, prefill, probing) requires a vLLM server; only Gemini + the judges go through OpenRouter. Config in `config/models.yaml`.
- The capability-benchmark Hub paths/splits are best-effort defaults (called out in DESIGN.md §6.5) — the one spot a maintainer may need to adjust.

Suggested first step when you're ready to run: `python experiments/preflight.py --ping` to validate config/keys/connectivity before kicking off the sweep.
